summary.ru: Кристофер II или Христофор II — король Дании с 13 ноября 1319 по 7 июня 1326 года и с 23 февраля 1330 года — единолично.
summary.en: Christopher II was King of Denmark from 1320 to 1326 and again from 1329 until his death. He was a younger son of Eric V. His name is connected with national disaster, as his rule ended in a near-total dissolution of the Danish state.
